'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Master Hooky DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Master Hooky]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Nickname as written. Informal abbreviations expanded best-effort. Starting written Local Hub/Office — treated as Hunt Down from package.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Master Hooky]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
